premises.text: Data privacy is a significant challenge for companies building AI software due to regulatory pressures.
premises.evidence_span: this has caused data privacy to be the biggest challenge for companies to build AI software today

premises.text: Accessing data takes a long time due to privacy engineering, legal, and security processes.
premises.evidence_span: It takes a long time to get access to data. Data is either locked away or they have to go through a long process, including privacy engineering, legal, and security

premises.text: Synthetic data can be generated from private real data while maintaining its properties.
premises.evidence_span: We convert private real data into 100% anonymized synthetic data that has the same properties as the real data

premises.text: Confidential computing allows companies to compute on encrypted data without accessing the raw data.
premises.evidence_span: we introduce confidential computing where you can compute on encrypted data so companies don't have to trust us with data because we can't even see it

premises.text: Data tokenization ensures companies fully own their data with tamper-proof logs.
premises.evidence_span: Companies own their data fully, and we have tamper-proof logs for that as well

premises.text: Companies can collaborate on encrypted data sets to gain insights about their customers.
premises.evidence_span: companies can collaborate on data sets together and understand more about their combined and common customers

premises.text: Synthetic data can be used for analytics and machine learning with performance similar to real data.
premises.evidence_span: synthetic data can be used just like the real data, for your analytics, for your machine learning

premises.text: The market for synthetic data is rapidly growing and expected to reach a billion dollars in five years.
premises.evidence_span: it's going to be a billion dollars in just five years

value.text: Companies can innovate on data quickly while ensuring customer privacy.
value.evidence_span: companies can innovate on data in days and not months

notes: Pilot production counts and partnerships are excluded as traction.
